outputs.explanation: Panel A includes a bar graph (lower graph) of HMGB1 signal intensity (Nuc/Cyto) per genotype shown as mean ± SD with error bars only; no individual data points (dots) are overlaid on the bars despite N=4, n>100 replicates being available.
The lower bar graph in panel B shows % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells as mean ± SD (N=4 mice) without individual data points plotted over the bars.
Panel C is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel D is a line plot (time on rotarod across weeks for each genotype); line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since overlaying points would make them unreadable.
Panel E consists of line plots (rotarod time across days 1-3 at 5w, 9w, 21w); line plots are exempt from this check.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve, a line plot type, which is exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel G shows micrograph images (Calbindin/DAPI staining), not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.

Panel H contains two bar graphs (molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number per field) presented as mean ± SD across nine mice per group (N=3, n=9), but no individual data points are shown overlaid on the bars.
